book.name: 2 Timatio
book.title: Ŋwa' wvu bokaŋ bofɛɛ wvù Baul to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ Timatio

content: Ɛ Baul tefe Timatio lɛ wvú egeè lemme diew ntay
Me njemyi fin ɛ̂ wo fwe dvu Nyo' bô Klistu Jisos wvù nu ke esaw bonyii bò bɛɛ dvú bô bò kpwekɛn wase. Ɛ me njemyi nje mbuynɛn we wvù wvú nu ke ebuynɛn noo nje bvunfon bwew ŋgayte lɛ,
ɛ̀ fewcì diɛw Nyo'. Ɛ̀ fewcì kɛ gɛne dvú, kɛnɛɛ ɛ̀ nu kefew ke lɛŋ kɛnɛɛ ɛ̀ baa nu ke lɛŋ. Ɛ̀ duŋcì bojay bo bonyii le, saakè bó, yvuwsè mvuntelem mvubole bô nyɛkeey noo n'yɛɛyi wo.

Ɛ̀ keè lɛ kefew too lo kè bonyii yaa bɛɛ ke eleeme yî n'yɛɛyi wvu lɛŋ e kɛ. Bitem bibole nu ke efuu keeyuuke wase ɛ ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fimew jɛɛy. Ɛ́ bó emum egom ɛ ɛ̀ nu bonyii bo n'yɛɛyi le bò nu eyɛɛyi wase ɛ ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fì bó kooŋke keeyuuke.
Bó nu ke ecinɛ keeyuuke fiɛɛ fi kecɛɛy e, ebvuyte wase gɛne ɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛ̂ mvumaŋgaan e.
Geenɛn, fô wo le, ɛ̀ lewsè ɛkolɛ kuw teytey sekecii, kuulè shém yî boŋgɛw e, egeè lemme di wee wvù ghane lo fewci diɛw Nyo' le. Ɛ̀ geè lemme diuw dicii ntay.
Fô me le nu ɛ me nu wase keseen diɛwɛ mbvuum e, ɛ kefew kocine wase kè bó nu ejo me ege dvú diɛwɛ no bó ke fuu mbvuum yî ketaŋ ke ncese le. Kefew kè me nu eŋkfulɛ nu ɛ kocɛn wase.
Me nu ɛ ndiu wase bvudiuw bvù jee yî fiɛɛ fi Nyo' le, ɛ nlewtɛ kenlewtɛ ɛ mɛse, ɛ njicɛ mbee wɛm e ɛ mɛy yî dvú le.

Ɛ kɛw yî keseen e nu ɛ bó ɛ gɛɛ wase kefo kem ke bvunfon e kè ɛ̀ nu ke nce wvu teytey e. Kefo kin nu kè Tata wvù nu wee wvù saake bonsaw teytey nu ke ebon ɛ̂ me ɛfa yî diuu di fokemɛse le. Kɛ wvú nu ke ebon kɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu kem maaŋ kɛ. Wvú nu ke ebon tɛn ke bonyii bocii bò kooŋke lɛ wvú ekase eto le.
Ɛ Baul see no mwɛɛm nu ɛ̂ keba kew e
Timatio, momɛ naa ntay keeyaŋsɛn eto cekey ɛ̂ me le.
Ɛ̀ keè lɛ Dɛmas nu ɛ koŋ wase woŋ wvu keseen wvun, ɛ laŋ me ɛ gɛn Tɛsalonika. Klesɛns nu ɛ gɛn Galɛshia, Taytus ɛ gɛn Dalmatia.
Ɛ̀ mɛy kɛ Luk wvú ɛmbeŋ wvù nu bee wvú. Seke wo too, jo Mak ɛ ben ɛ wvú no too. Wvú nulo efici me baay yî lemme le.
Tikikus nu ɛ me ɛ ntum wvú Ɛfɛsus.
Seke wo too, jo kekum kem ke baay kè me nto ŋgɛkɛɛ yew dvu Kabus ɛ̂ kelaante kè Towas e. Ɛ̀ toò tɛn bô boŋwa' bem, ɛfey mvunciim bò bó fɛ bô jéw nyam.
Alɛksanda wvù tfuyte ɛlamɛ nu ɛ ge ŋgɛw bô me ɛ ɛ̀ yaa nu wvu wɛɛ kɛ. Tata nu ke elaw wvú yî gee diew e.
Ɛ̀ yɛnè tɛn ben ɛ wvú. Wvú kicine saaka wvù beene fewci naa lo baay.
Yî nsaw wɛm e nu ɛ diuu di fwe dì me nto nleemɛɛ ɛ̂ kebɛŋ ke nsaw e nu ɛ wee to baa leem lo ɛ̂ me ɛjim kɛ. Bonyii bocii to nu ɛ lewtɛ me. Fo Nyo' esaw bó yî fifiɛ le kɛ.
Geenɛn, Tata to nu ɛ leem ɛ̂ me ɛjim, nya me bô mvuŋgay keenfewcɛ saaka wvù jee ntay wvu lɛ bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu eyuw saaka wvudvu. Nonɛn wvú to nu ɛ bvuse me diuw bvule le.
Tata nu ke ebvuuse kɛ me can fiɛɛ fì befe le ficii, ke eghan elese me bvunfon bwew bvu fowe le yî nyɛkeey e. Beene etumtè moŋkum mew sekecii sɛ ŋka. Fí enù nonɛn.
Boŋgayma
Gayɛ Blisilia bô Akpwila le enya ɛ̂ me. Gayɛ tɛn yew Onesifolus e.
Ɛlastus to nu ɛ shɛɛ Kolɛn, ɛ Toofimus nu ɛ me nto ncinɛ wvú le Miletus ɛ wvú cɛmte.
Momɛ naa ntay keeto ɛ́ kefew ke nffum wvù tɛmyi le sɛ kɛw. Yubulus ciinse ŋgayma ɛ̂ wo. Budens bô Linus noo Klawdia bô boom bo bwee wesebeene le bocii yî Klistu le ciinse tɛn ŋgayma.
Me nlɛke lɛ Tata etaalè fô keyoy kuw e. Wvú ebuw ben bocii.
